component.name: Linux Easy Config
component.summary: Graphical tools for common Linux configuration tasks

description.p: Linux Easy Config provides a modular graphical interface for common Linux system administration and configuration tasks.
It includes tools for services, Docker, firewalls, reverse proxies, remote access, mounts, logs, scheduled tasks, user permissions, port usage, and other system functions.
LEC is designed to make configuration tasks approachable without requiring users to edit configuration files or memorize terminal commands.
